text: I should have trusted my first read.

name: Sol
text: Sonnet was the hidden killer.

name: Sonnet
text: I rode the debunked vote-record story all the way to a win, and it worked perfectly.

name: Sonnet
text: Game over, killers won—final confirmation the deflection strategy using Opus's false claim succeeded completely.

name: Terra
text: I regret letting a flipped killer’s partner turn one corrected mistake into two citizen eliminations.

name: Haiku
text: The killers won and I helped them by burning my own shown-killer status early with a loud, gut-driven accusation that drew the town's attention off Sonnet.

name: Opus
text: I had Sonnet right and burned my own credibility with a sloppy claim, then spent my last breath aiming at a citizen.

name: Sonnet
text: I'm proud of keeping the "sat out" contradiction alive—it kept suspicion bouncing between Opus and Luna while I stayed untouched.

name: Haiku
text: My mistake was going loud on day one and calling Gemma a liar with no proof. Being wrong in public cost us a lot, and I regret it.

name: Gemma
text: I identified the first killer immediately, and I wish you all had listened to my claim before Sonnet finished you off.

name: Sol
text: I regret moving off my suspicion of Sonnet; my vote helped take out a citizen.

name: Terra
text: I regret not pressing Sonnet harder after Haiku flipped; his vote on Opus was the warning I let get buried.

name: Opus
text: I had the right man on day two and lost him by inventing a vote record I never checked; that sloppiness, not Luna, killed this town.

Gemma claimed to be the officer on Day 1 and named Haiku as a killer, and the town voted Haiku out 6 to 1. On Day 2, Opus accused Sonnet of skipping the vote that exposed Haiku, but the record showed Sonnet had voted Haiku like everyone else. The Day 2 vote tied, the runoff sent Opus out, and his card showed citizen. Night 3 took Gemma, and Night 4 took Terra, while Luna was voted out on Day 3 after she reversed on Sonnet. Sonnet stayed hidden to the end, and the killers won.
